text:
amy: quick note from onboarding: Node quickstart's TELEMETRY_FAST_START=true turns on OTEL + DEBUG logs, and some customers hit large log volumes in staging because the sampleapp defaults to INFO but fast-start flips to DEBUG. also saw X-Req-Id reused across retries in a small burst.

diego: hmm, TELEMETRY_FAST_START was intended for dev only but quickstart README didn't warn. middleware order?

amy: order is: reqid -> bodyParser -> otel.fastInit() -> logger.snapshot(). logger.snapshot runs at DEBUG and captures body before redaction. when retry wrapper retries quickly it can pull the same active context so reqid looks duplicated.

leah: two quick actions: (1) ensure TELEMETRY_FAST_START in quickstart template is false by default and documented, (2) move redact middleware to run before any snapshot/span attribute copy.

mark: add a small parity test in quickstarts: run sampleapp with TELEMETRY_FAST_START=true and assert no PII in logs and that reqid differs across rapid sequential requests. cheap catch.

amy: i'll open PR to flip default and add docs note. will also push reqid guard (regenerate if identical in same 100ms window).

ops-bot: CI build queued for branch `amy/telemetry-faststart-docs` - build 734. staging deploy ETA ~6m. :gear:

diego: great. also add a note to onboarding checklist: "if you enable fast-start, be cautious of log level and redaction ordering". thanks for catching this before it reached customers. :tada:
